name: Hope Finance
rootCause: Hope Finance lost $1.86 million on Arbitrum One after a multisig-approved malicious router siphoned user assets at launch. Three out of four multisig owners signed a router update, enabling an attacker to drain WETH and USDC from the protocol's GenesisRewardPool. Three Hope Finance multisig owners approved a malicious router contract pre-launch, granting an attacker wallet direct withdrawal capability from user pools via the GenesisRewardPool contract's openTrade function.

descriptions.text: Abandon Hope all ye who enter here. $1.86M was rugged from Hope Finance yesterday. It’s impossible to know whether the doxxed individual accused by the team is truly to blame. Don’t get your Hopes up.

Hope Finance lost $1.86 million on Arbitrum One after a multisig-approved malicious router siphoned user assets at launch. Three out of four multisig owners signed a router update, enabling an attacker to drain WETH and USDC from the protocol's GenesisRewardPool. Three Hope Finance multisig owners approved a malicious router contract pre-launch, granting an attacker wallet direct withdrawal capability from user pools via the GenesisRewardPool contract's openTrade function.
